notes.title: Yet another Hotfix
notes.content:
Removed a "mystery button" that appears during on of Sherry's questioning segments that resets the encounter

Fixed a bug with a case 2 gallery scene not unlocking properly

notes.title: Yet another Hotfix
notes.content:
Corrected a bug with a futa scene appearing for non-futa players in Case 2

Also added the Polaris x Fizz x Max scene to case 2's gallery (which was accidentally absent)

notes.title: Hotfix: Gallery edition
notes.content:
Fixed some mistakes with Gallery items overlapping one another and also put in the Shiki animation in the gallery that was missing and corrected typos.

Case 3 gallery unlocks for Bull/Hyena/and Fizz carry may need to be reunlocked

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Removed buttons on the titlescreen for discord etc
Personally I think they look nice but steam doesn't like those, so they had to go ːsteamsadː

Also fixed some typos and issues with Max not gaining charge with certain Fizz scenes

notes.title: Launch Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed issue with Max not regaining charge on certain Merlot scenes in case 1
Fixed issue with textbox disappearing on certain Cham questions
Fixed typos during Shiki's Quiz

notes.title: Launch!
notes.content:
Erotic Justice is finally released!

Thank you to everyone that's been following the project :D

It means so much to finally see the game come out on a major platform

I hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it
